definition_and_caveat: Stable file-level module proxy; same file can recur in several releases.
Derived from the first directory under org/apache/calcite; this is an analysis grouping, not an instructor-provided component field.
Java for all selected Calcite rows.
Apache Calcite subset.
One of 16 Calcite releases, 1.0.0 through 1.15.0.
Semantic version order; calendar release dates are unavailable.
SM_file_loc in the prepared data.
SM_class_wmc_sum; sum of class weighted methods per file.
SM_class_wmc_avg; average class weighted methods per file.
SM_class_cbo_sum; sum of class coupling-between-objects values per file.
SM_class_cbo_avg; average class CBO per file.
BUGFIX_count from prepared release-level source.
MOSER_authors; distinct developers who modified the file.
MOSER_revisions; count of file revisions, used as an activity proxy, not an exact assignment commit table.
MOSER_sum_code_churn; additions minus deletions, so negative values are valid.
Derived as MOSER_sum_lines_added + MOSER_sum_lines_deleted; proxy for total change activity, not test coverage or commit-level churn.
MOSER_avg_code_churn; signed net change average; not used as total change volume.
Defect count divided by file LOC/1000 within each module-release row; descriptive and sensitive to small files.
Unique issue identifiers deduplicated per file and release from bug_fixes JSON; totals reconcile to BUGFIX_count across selected rows.
No coverage field was found in the selected Calcite tables. Kept unavailable; never imputed as zero.
Calendar release dates are not provided in the selected table; release order is used for trend charts.
